# Data model: Project website

## Milestone (`site/src/data/milestones.yaml`)

| Field | Type | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | `M0` … `M8`, unique |
| `title` | string | short name, as in README |
| `scope` | string | one sentence |
| `status` | enum | `done` · `in-progress` · `planned` |
| `proposed` | bool, optional | marks a milestone not yet agreed (M8) |

At most one milestone should be `in-progress` (AGENTS.md rule 5: one thing at a time). Status changes by PR, together with the devlog entry.

## Page (generated by `sync-docs.mjs`)

| Field | Source |
|---|---|
| `title` | first `# Heading` of the source file (fallback: file name) |
| `route` | see [contracts/site-routes.md](contracts/site-routes.md) |
| body | source Markdown minus the first heading, links rewritten |
| `editUrl` | `docs/<path>` on GitHub (Starlight "Edit page") |

## Requirements report (static, generated in CI)

`/requirements/` = StrictDoc HTML export (`index.html`), `traceability.html`, `reqif/output.reqif`.
